dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Lil' Fungi Playground...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's kinda curious too. Take these counters, for example. Besides providing a place for our friends to rest and have fun, they've gotta have some other use, right?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Yes, they do. The foot traffic through Bayda Harbor is ideal, so I'm planning to use this place as a platform to help more people understand how gentle Fungi can be.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Besides selling the finished Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta tabletop game, those interested can also interact briefly with Kindlejoy and Blitzara under my guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Once I'm done with "On Fungi Communities," I'll be selling copies here too.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: In time, more people will start to see that you can trust some gentle, intelligent Fungi. They've got what it takes to be great partners, just like the Saurians in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Plus, when the time is right, if we ever host more beast tamer tournaments, this would be a great operational base.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! So this place doubles as a spot for you to promote your theories and a support hub for future events.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, Paimon just remembered. You mentioned the Natlanese and their Saurian companions. Have you and your Fungi friends traveled through Natlan before?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Not quite. We only made it as far as the northwest desert. We couldn't find a way across to Natlan at the time, so we turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But as luck would have it, we ran into some folks from Natlan on holiday. I wound up hitting it off with a lady in a red hat.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: After talking to her, I learned so much more about how much the people in Natlan rely on and trust their Saurian companions...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, that lady mentioned she'd actually met you before, and she even told me all about your legendary exploits in Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Heh. You never cease to amaze me. You never stop being awe-inspiring adventurers who swoop in just in time to save the day, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I've heard about this before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone we know, then? Let me think... Could it be Nusta? Yeah, sounds like it could be her...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really? What a small world!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, we did fight alongside quite a few tribal warriors in Natlan. It's not an exaggeration to say we're pretty famous over there!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: You'll likely be busy traveling to other far-off lands soon, right?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I'm going to do my best to look after our Fungi friends so you can focus on those urgent matters worry-free. I'll make sure they enjoy happy, carefree lives!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon's sure they're in good hands!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even a food lover like Paimon can't guarantee that Bongo-Head can be perfectly satisfied every single meal, or grow stronger and sturdier every year!
